🍯 Honey Data — Signed Training Pairs

Every (prompt, response, model, weights_CID) tuple is signed by meok-sovereign-spine-mcp. Authority accrues only on external recompute.

� What "honey data" means here

Honey data is signed training pairs. Until a (prompt, response) tuple is routed through meok-sovereign-spine-mcp sign_card(kind="honey-data"), it is an unprovenanced log — not an asset. The spine-mcp signs every tuple with a CID + Ed25519 sig + pub_key before it enters the training pipeline. Recompute the CID from the original payload and you can verify it came from this signer.

1
Capture — Arena runs emit (prompt, response, model, weights_CID) tuples. Source: /api/sov-arena/rounds.jsonl (400 rounds streaming live).
2
Sign — spine-mcp computes canonical JSON, SHA-256 CID, signs with Ed25519. 5 card kinds; "honey-data" is the training pair kind.
3
Verify — External party recomputes CID from payload, checks sig. Authority = external recompute, never assertion.
4
Train — Signed pairs enter the distillation pipeline. Gate: no unsigned log ever trains.

🍯 The 5 card kinds (recap)

M
measurement — a measurement result (Wilson CI, McNemar p, axis/metric/value/n). Examples: governance 0.249 [0.198, 0.308] @ n=237.
A
arena-round — a single arena comparison (probe, left, right, agreement). Examples: clan-csoai-cited vs clan-meok-operational on EU AI Act Art 50.
H
honey-data — a signed training pair (prompt, response, model, weights_CID). Examples: (probe text, verdict, clan-cited:latest, sha256:weights...).
P
provenance — an attestation (who built what from where). Examples: in-toto/SLSA-style statements.
C
charter — a council decision / vote. Examples: 33-voter quorum tally on a proposal.
⚠ What "honey data" does NOT mean:
• Not "infinite memory" — every card lives somewhere with a CID. Storage scales with corpus size; latency scales with retrieval. No infinite.
• Not "automatically trained" — signing is necessary but not sufficient. The training pipeline gates retrain on held-out recompute + Deflated Sharpe Ratio, not on signed count alone.
• Not "verified correctness" — Ed25519 sig proves provenance/integrity. The model's answer is still subject to held-out measurement. Sign ≠ correct.
• Not "free to publish raw" — signed cards are public; raw training corpora (honey KBs) are not. The signed-card ledger is open; the underlying KB is internal.
• Not "always safe to ship" — every honey-data card with training_eligible=true is a candidate for distillation, not a guarantee. Reviewers still gate.
